mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_system (id, tenant_id, name, description) VALUES (#{system.id}, #{system.tenantId}, #{system.name}, #{system.description})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS member_id, a.display_name, g.action FROM c2k_system_grant g JOIN c2k_account a ON a.id = g.member_id AND a.tenant_id = g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.system_id = #{systemId} ORDER BY a.username
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_system_grant (tenant_id, system_id, member_id, action) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{systemId}, #{memberId}, 'catalog.read') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
